newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria calls new tender for Sofia's trade centre.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria calls new tender for Sofia's trade centre.

text.p: Bulgaria's Privatisation Agency said on Tuesday it had called a new tender for 70 percent of the Interpred World Trade Centre in Sofia after its sale fell through last year.
"The Privatisation Agency will accept bids for a 70 percent stake in Interpred until 1500 local time on March 26," an agency official told Reuters.

In November last year the Privatisation Agency cancelled the sale of 70 percent of Interpred shares to Bulgaria's Maxcom Hold after Maxcom failed to complete payment of $34 million agreed under the sell-off contract.

Maxcom was to have paid in cash thirty percent of the price one month after the signing of the contract and the rest in government bonds a month later. -- Roumiana Tikholova, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
